about: The room that asks goes silent: the target is 21, the room is 18 and then 22 from 200 s, so the house is warm and the working fire goes down to smouldering; at 260 s the sensor of the room says nothing - three periods of its round later (6 s) the role says nothing and the house says cold because its source is silent: the smouldering fire works again, by the water, which is under the line; at 420 s the room answers 22 and the house is warm again.
